## How to use this booklet

This booklet is a map of crochet, one of the four Needle Arts on Curious Sparoows (with Knitting, Embroidery and Sewing). Every entry tells you, in one or two lines, what a tool, stitch, technique, style or project is. Every entry has an ID (such as CRO-07.6 for amigurumi) that is also its address on the website.

- **Parts** are the big branches; **Sections** (CRO-01, CRO-02...) are the main topics.
- **Entries** carry a ☐ box: tick it when you have learned or made it.
- **Registers** give US and UK stitch names, 24 projects with level, yarn, hook and time, and a history timeline.
- Start with **Part 0**, five two-minute questions.
